experiment_title: DCGAN Epoch Scaling Experiment (25 vs 50 Epochs)

empirical_findings.loss_convergence: Adversarial equilibrium maintained around D loss ~ 0.85-0.90 and G loss ~ 1.50.
empirical_findings.sample_diversity: Diversity score remained consistent, confirming no mode collapse occurred during extended training.
empirical_findings.visual_quality: Extended training resulted in smoother line contours and improved high-frequency structural definition on complex garments.
